priorityList: --- Icy Veins Rotation (Priority List) ---
Cast Stormkeeper ~3 seconds before the pull.
Cast Lava Burst ~1.5 second before the pull so it lands right after the pull.
Cast Lightning Bolt.
Cast Lava Burst.
Proceed with regular rotation.
Cast Stormkeeper.
Cast Voltaic Blaze.
Cast Stormkeeper. Make sure the procs are available during Ascendance, typically cast one or two GCDs before it .
Cast Ascendance, sync it with on-use trinkets, Bloodlust, Tempered Potion.
Cast Earth Shock if Ascendance will fade within the next 3 seconds.
Cast Elemental Blast if Ascendance will fade within the next 3 seconds.
Refresh Voltaic Blaze if Ascendance will fade within the next 3 seconds.
Refresh Flame Shock if Ascendance will fade within the next 3 seconds.
Cast Voltaic Blaze to refresh Flame Shock when it has 6 seconds or less remaining, use the window you have to optimize your movement with this flexible instant cast.
Refresh Flame Shock when it has 6 seconds or less remaining, use the window you have to optimize your movement with this flexible instant cast.
Cast Tempest. If possible, try casting Tempest with the Master of the Elements buff.
Cast Tempest.
Cast Earth Shock whenever you are less than 15 Maelstrom from capping or when Master of the Elements is up.
Cast Elemental Blast whenever you are less than 15 Maelstrom from capping or when Master of the Elements is up .
Cast Earth Shock whenever you are less than 15 Maelstrom from capping.
Cast Elemental Blast whenever you are less than 15 Maelstrom from capping.
Cast Lava Burst if Flame Shock is up and Master of the Elements is not up.
Cast Lava Burst if Flame Shock is up.
Cast Stormkeeper. Make sure it is available during Ascendance.
Cast Earthquake.
Cast Earthquake if there are at least 5 targets.
Cast Elemental Blast if there are at most 4 targets.
If there are at most 3 targets, keep one Flame Shock up.
Cast Chain Lightning.
Use Lava Surge while moving.
